[[Chitin Fragment]] is a common crafting material used in armor crafting.

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[material trader]]s.
* [[Salvage Kit|Salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Chitin Fragments (see below).
** See [[:Category:Contains chitin]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Chitin Fragments see [[:Category:Drops chitin]].

== Trivia ==
* Chitin Fragments were called '''Shells''' prior to the [[Game updates/20060309|Thursday March 9th 2006 update]].

* The skins of most insects consist of [[w:chitin|chitin]], a hard organic carbohydrate material, similar in texture to horn (keratin) and in structure to cellulose.
